clause: DESIGN R3.3 §9.4 Region geometry, including Process IO
witness: a tall object without label next to a short object with a tall label: centres on one line and the body grows to contain the union
derivation: Tokens 0/0/10000/0, body (0,0,400000,50000): X 40000x100000 (no label), Y 40000x20000 with label 30000x60000, no anchors: lefts 0, 50000; RH = max(0, max(100000, 80000)) = 100000; A = 50000, B = max(50000, 10000 + 60000) = 70000, A + B = 120000 > RH, so cy = 0 + max(50000, (100000 + 50000 - 70000)/2) = 50000 (union top on the body top): X at y 0, Y at y 40000, its label at (55000, 60000); height' = max(50000, 100000, 50000 + 70000) = 120000; pageBounds (0,0,400000,120000). Row rule (spec §4.3): items in §7.2 placement order; footprint max(object, label) width; left = anchor centre - footprint/2 when the anchor is shown, else contentLeft or previous right + gap; clamp to contentLeft; collision shifts right; one row at the top of the support body [Ly, Ly+RH], RH = max(minHeight, max(object+label) + 2 padding) (harmonization K2); every object centre lies on one line cy = Ly + max(A, (RH + A - B)/2), A = max h/2, B = max(h/2 + label height), so the union of the stacks is centred in the row (DESIGN §9.4 'align centers on one IO row'); exact rationals, one roundEven per output coordinate.
